response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM linked), telescope_weather AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift FROM linked GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_modindex) AS avg_modulation_index, AVG(g.avg_phase_shift) AS avg_phase_shift, AVG(g.avg_modindex - b.avg_modindex) AS avg_above_baseline FROM telescope_weather AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex GROUP BY g.weathprofile;
